lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏒᎾ?  ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ?
lines.text: Hi-a-no ni-du-we-se-le-i, Ga-do-no ni-tsi-s-ga-sv-na?  Ga-do di-ga-li-s-do-di ni-tso-hi-yu-sv-na i-gi?
lines.english: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎢᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
lines.text: U-tsa-ti-no u-ni-s-ga-le-i, a-le hi-a ni-du-na-da-we-se-le-i, Ga-do u-s-di hi-a a-s-ga-ya, na-s-quo-ye-no u-no-le a-le v-da-li i-gv-wo-hi-yu-hv-s-ga.
lines.english: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
